source.rawText: Synthetic SiteScribe test package with 10 main records and 2 secondary update/comment records per main record.

dailySummary: Test package containing 10 SiteScribe Review Console records across the native two-level model. Each main record includes exactly two secondary update/comment items for UI testing.

records.description: Crane arrived on site and was staged near the north access lane.
records.sourceText: Event: Crane arrived on site and was staged near the north access lane.

comments.text: Operator checked in with the site supervisor before setup.
North access lane remained passable after staging.

records.description: Loose blocking material was observed near the east pedestrian path.
records.sourceText: Safety: Loose blocking material was observed near the east pedestrian path.

flags.sourceText: Loose blocking material was observed near the east pedestrian path.

comments.text: Area was marked for cleanup before lunch.
Supervisor to confirm which contractor left the material.

records.description: Request updated lift plan from crane supplier.
records.sourceText: Action: Request updated lift plan from crane supplier.

comments.text: Confirm lift radius and landing zone are included in the updated plan.
Attach site access note when sending the request.

records.description: Follow up with concrete supplier about revised delivery window.
records.sourceText: Follow-up: Follow up with concrete supplier about revised delivery window.

comments.text: Delivery window needs to avoid crane setup time.
Record confirmation once supplier replies.

records.sourceText: Scheduled: Site inspection scheduled for 2026-06-16 at 10:00.

comments.text: Prepare access route and current safety records before inspection.
Notify subcontractor leads that inspector will be on site.

records.description: Send site notice reminding contractors to keep the east gate clear.
records.sourceText: Communication: Send site notice reminding contractors to keep the east gate clear.

flags.sourceText: Send site notice reminding contractors to keep the east gate clear.

comments.text: Include reminder that gate access is required for deliveries and emergency access.
Copy site manager once notice is prepared.

records.description: Crane supplier insurance certificate is required before lift work proceeds.
records.sourceText: Document: Crane supplier insurance certificate is required before lift work proceeds.

comments.text: Check whether the current certificate is already on file.
If missing, request certificate from supplier before end of day.

records.description: Rebar delivery arrived short of the requested quantity.
records.sourceText: Event: Rebar delivery arrived short of the requested quantity.

flags.sourceText: Rebar delivery arrived short of the requested quantity.

comments.text: Delivery slip should be checked against the purchase order.
Supplier follow-up may be required after quantity is confirmed.

records.description: Work area near overhead wires requires review before equipment movement.
records.sourceText: Safety: Work area near overhead wires requires review before equipment movement.

comments.text: Confirm safe limits of approach before equipment enters the area.
Add warning note to site briefing before next shift.

records.description: Clear temporary material from the west access route.
records.sourceText: Action: Clear temporary material from the west access route.

comments.text: Access route should be clear before afternoon deliveries.
Take a follow-up photo after cleanup is complete.
